generatedFieldGroups.reason: The active blog listing and article UI used hardcoded English. Fixed localized UI copy was generated for all non-English routes.

migratedFieldGroups.reason: Active localized transitional blog content was migrated to Portable Text and remains marked generated until human language review.
Localized accessibility text was populated from each active post title and author name.

technicalCorrections: Internal Robusst links in localized article bodies were normalized to the current locale.
Canonical and hreflang values now identify each genuinely localized article instead of forcing the English canonical.
Dates and number formatting now use the active route locale.
